Dry week with 0.61" ETo, average high 71.7F, low 52.2F. .Interesting statistics:  6 of the original 10 CoCoRaHS stations in Humboldt County are still active, all begun between September and November of 2008.  Of Humboldt County's total of 225 stations, 152 are still active, 67.5%.  Compare this to Larimer County, Colorado, home to CoCoRaHS at Fort Collins.  Of their first 172 stations, only 10 are still active, 5.8%.  I say congratulations to everyone as we approach the 18th anniversary of having CoCoRaHS here on the North Coast.
